title: Ion/dipole interactions in novel solvation structures for rechargeable batteries: a review
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,411-445
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05198C, Review Article
Ke-Feng Ren, Zhong-Yu Li, Xin Shen, Cong Guo, Weizhai Bao, Feng Yu, Ebrahim Nemati-Kande, Long Kong, He Liu, Xin-Bing Cheng, Jingfa Li
This review highlights the recent progress of novel solvations based on ion/dipole interactions and analyzes the working principles and the future directions, aiming to construct a specific design paradigm of electrolytes in rechargeable batteries.
